name: voice-mode
description: Voice mode for any agent in any space: the Voice pane in Settings shows which speech engines are ready, which voices exist (yours, your workspace's, a plugin's) and which agent sounds like what, and which live voice Talk live would open. The speaking itself is the engine's reply vocalizer; open voice options from the small dot left of the composer microphone to turn it on or off. The microphone itself is for dictation.
